note: Every key fact a case relies on. source: one or more places the fact is stated, as file#H2 heading; any one of them counts as retrieved.

fare-min-sl.text: In Santa Lucia the minimum fare is ₱40, covering the first kilometer and up to 2 passengers.

fare-km-sl.text: Each additional kilometer in Santa Lucia costs ₱15.

fare-extra-pax.text: Each passenger beyond 2 costs ₱10 flat, regardless of distance.

fare-wait.text: Free waiting time at pickup is 3 minutes; after that waiting costs ₱2 per minute.

fare-wait-plus.text: Tricycall Plus members get 5 minutes of free waiting time instead of 3.

fare-surge.text: During high demand (such as heavy rain or rush hour) surge pricing can raise the fare by up to 1.5x; the multiplier is shown before you confirm.

fare-estimate-diff.text: The final fare can differ from the estimate if the driver takes a different route because of traffic or road closures, or if there is extra waiting time.

fare-disc-list.text: Legally mandated discounts: students 20%, senior citizens 20%, PWD 20%, solo parents 10%, each with a valid ID.

fare-disc-student.text: Students get 20% off with a valid school ID.

fare-disc-senior.text: Senior citizens get 20% off with a valid senior citizen ID.

fare-disc-scope.text: Mandated discounts apply to the base fare and distance charge only, not to surge, waiting charges or surcharges.

fare-disc-one.text: Only one mandated discount applies per trip; if a passenger qualifies for more than one, the larger is used.

fare-dispute.text: To report an incorrect charge, open the trip in Trip History and tap "Report a fare issue" within 7 days.

fare-pay.text: Standard rides can be paid in cash or in-app (wallet, GCash, Maya, debit card); scheduled rides and Pasabuy are in-app only.

area-sr-min.text: San Roque's minimum fare is ₱35 for the first kilometer and up to 2 passengers.

area-sr-km-old.text: The Service Areas page lists San Roque at ₱12 per additional kilometer, the rate before August 15, 2026.

upd-sr-km.text: Since August 15, 2026, each additional kilometer in San Roque costs ₱13 (up from ₱12); the ₱35 minimum fare did not change.

area-list.text: Tricycall runs only in Santa Lucia and San Roque; Villa Aurora is planned; it is not available anywhere else, including Metro Manila, Cebu and Davao.

area-same.text: A ride must start and end in the same service area.

area-driver-mtop.text: A driver can only accept rides in the area where their MTOP was issued; to work in another area they need that area's MTOP, submit it in the app and change their service area.

book-types.text: Tricycall offers Standard rides, Sabay shared rides, Scheduled rides and Pasabuy errands.

book-standard.text: A Standard ride is the whole tricycle, for up to 3 passengers, and is exclusive: no other passengers are picked up.

book-nodriver.text: If no driver is found within 3 minutes you are not charged; you can move your pickup pin to a main road or terminal, or try again later.

canc-free.text: Cancelling is free within 2 minutes of booking, and within 3 minutes after a driver has been assigned.

canc-fee-old.text: The Cancellations page states a ₱20 fee for cancelling after the free window or after the driver arrives.

upd-canc-fee.text: Since September 1, 2026, the passenger cancellation fee is ₱25 (up from ₱20), and it goes to the driver in full; the free cancellation windows did not change.

canc-steps.text: To cancel: open the active trip screen, tap "Cancel ride", choose a reason, and confirm.
source: cancellations.md#How to cancel as a passenger

canc-noarrive.text: If the driver never arrives and the trip auto-cancels, the passenger is not charged; a driver more than 10 minutes late can also be cancelled without a fee.

ver-docs.text: Driver applicants upload a driver's license, OR/CR, MTOP, a tricycle photo showing the plate, a government ID matching the license, and a selfie.

ver-time.text: Driver verification usually takes 2 to 5 business days.

ver-reject.text: Common rejection reasons are blurry photos, an expired license or MTOP, a name mismatch, an OR/CR that doesn't match the tricycle, or an MTOP for another area; resubmitting is free and unlimited.

rate-window.text: Ratings can be submitted within 24 hours after the trip ends.

safe-sos.text: The SOS button shares the live trip location with Tricycall's safety team and lets you call emergency services, with no confirmation needed.

safe-share.text: You can share your live trip with a trusted contact by link, even if they don't have the app.

safe-night.text: Between 10 PM and 5 AM, trips get trip-sharing suggestions and more frequent location tracking.

safe-severe.text: Severe safety reports such as reckless driving are prioritized and may lead to immediate suspension of the other party pending investigation.

disp-safety.text: Refunds connected to a safety incident are handled by the safety team, without a separate dispute.

wal-uses.text: Wallet credit pays for trips, Pasabuy orders and Tricycall Plus, and receives refunds, including refunds for cash trips.

wal-nowithdraw.text: Wallet credit cannot be withdrawn as cash or transferred to another person; it does not expire.

wal-topup.text: You can top up the wallet with GCash, Maya or a debit card (minimum ₱50).

wal-cash.text: Cash is available for Standard and Sabay rides.

sch-area-sl.text: Scheduled rides are available in Santa Lucia only, not yet in San Roque.

sch-window.text: Scheduled rides can be booked from 1 hour to 7 days ahead, with up to 3 upcoming at a time.
source: scheduled-rides.md#How far ahead you can book

sch-price.text: A scheduled ride's fare is fixed at booking and surge never applies; a ₱15 booking fee is added.

sch-plus-fee.text: Tricycall Plus members pay no scheduled-ride booking fee.

sch-disc.text: Mandated discounts and the night surcharge apply to scheduled rides as on any Standard ride.

sch-inapp.text: Scheduled rides can only be paid in-app (wallet, GCash, Maya or debit card), not in cash.

sch-assign.text: Tricycall starts looking for a driver 30 minutes before pickup; if none has accepted by 10 minutes before, the ride is cancelled with no charge.

sch-cancel.text: A scheduled ride can be changed or cancelled free up to 1 hour before pickup; later than that, the booking fee is kept.
source: scheduled-rides.md#Changing or cancelling a scheduled ride

upd-sch-3days.text: Until October 1, 2026, scheduled rides could be booked at most 3 days ahead; scheduled rides launched May 15, 2026.

sab-what.text: Sabay is a shared ride: you book one seat and the driver may pick up or drop off up to 2 other riders on your route.

sab-hours.text: Sabay runs from 6 AM to 9 PM only.

sab-seat.text: A Sabay seat costs 60% of the Standard fare for your route, rounded up to the nearest peso, with a ₱25 minimum.

sab-disc.text: Mandated discounts apply to Sabay seats, but the Tricycall Plus discount does not.

sab-bring.text: A Sabay booking is for 1 passenger only, with no large items and no pets.

sab-detour.text: A Sabay driver may make up to 2 detours, adding no more than 10 minutes compared with a Standard ride.

upd-sab-sr.text: Sabay launched in San Roque on July 1, 2026; it has run in Santa Lucia since April 1, 2026.

pas-hours.text: Pasabuy runs from 7 AM to 9 PM, in Santa Lucia and San Roque.

pas-budget.text: The Pasabuy item budget is up to ₱1,000 per order; you pay the exact receipt amount plus the delivery fee.

pas-inapp.text: Pasabuy orders can only be paid in-app, never in cash.

pas-fee.text: The Pasabuy delivery fee is the Standard fare from the store to you plus a ₱20 Pasabuy fee; mandated and Plus discounts do not apply.

pas-banned.text: Pasabuy drivers won't buy alcohol, tobacco or vapes, prescription medicines, live animals, cash, gift or load cards, or items over 10 kg or too large for the seat.

toda-list.text: Partner terminals: Santa Lucia Plaza (5 AM to 11 PM), Santa Lucia Town Hall (6 AM to 9 PM), San Roque Public Market (4 AM to 10 PM), San Roque Church (6 AM to 8 PM).

toda-queue.text: A pickup within 100 meters of an open partner terminal goes to the driver at the front of the terminal queue, not the nearest driver.

toda-members.text: Only drivers who are members of the terminal's TODA can join its queue.

toda-nowait.text: Pickups at a partner terminal have no waiting charge.

promo-rules.text: One promo code per trip; it can't be combined with a mandated discount (the app uses whichever saves more) but can be combined with Tricycall Plus.

promo-bagong.text: BAGONGRIDE gives ₱20 off the first Standard ride, for new accounts, until December 31, 2026.

promo-tagulan.text: TAGULAN25 (25% off Standard rides, up to ₱30) was valid from June 1 to September 30, 2026.

upd-tagulan.text: TAGULAN25 ended on September 30, 2026 and can no longer be used.

promo-excl.text: Promo codes do not apply to surcharges, waiting charges or the scheduled ride booking fee.

promo-ref.text: A friend who signs up with your code gets ₱30 off their first ride, and you get ₱30 wallet credit after their first ride, for up to 10 friends a month.

plus-price.text: Tricycall Plus costs ₱99 per month and renews automatically.

plus-areas.text: Tricycall Plus works in every service area.

upd-plus-price.text: Plus launched June 1, 2026 at ₱79 a month; it is ₱99 since September 1, 2026, and existing members move to ₱99 at their first renewal after that date.

plus-disc.text: Plus gives 10% off Standard rides, including scheduled rides, on the base fare and distance charge, with savings capped at ₱300 a month.

plus-priority.text: Plus members get priority matching during surge.

plus-not.text: The Plus discount doesn't apply to Sabay or Pasabuy, and can't be combined with a mandated discount (the larger is used); it can be combined with a promo code.

plus-pay.text: Plus is paid from the wallet, GCash, Maya or a debit card, not in cash.

plus-cancel.text: Cancel Plus from Profile, Tricycall Plus, Cancel membership; benefits continue until the end of the paid month, and unused days are not refunded.

sur-night.text: The night surcharge, for trips starting between 10 PM and 5 AM, is ₱10 in Santa Lucia and ₱8 in San Roque.

sur-large.text: Large items such as a sack of rice, a balikbayan box or a bicycle cost ₱10 per item, up to 2 per trip.

sur-terminal.text: Pickups at the San Roque Public Market terminal have a ₱5 terminal fee.

sur-order.text: Surcharges are added after discounts; no discount or promo reduces them, and surge never multiplies them.

drv-keep.text: Drivers keep the fare minus the service fee, plus all surcharges, waiting charges and extra-passenger charges.

drv-tiers.text: Driver tiers: Standard pays a 15% service fee; Silver (40+ trips and a 4.6+ rating) 13%; Gold (70+ trips and a 4.8+ rating) 11%.

drv-recalc.text: Tiers are recalculated every Monday from the previous week, and the new service fee applies from that Monday.

drv-sabay-count.text: Each Sabay rider counts as a separate trip for tiers and bonuses.

drv-pasabuy-fee.text: Drivers keep the whole ₱20 Pasabuy fee, with no service fee taken from it.

drv-bonus.text: 50 trips in a week earns a ₱300 bonus; 80 trips earns ₱600 instead (not ₱900).

drv-payout.text: Payouts are sent every Monday; the minimum is ₱100 and smaller balances roll over.

drv-cash.text: For cash trips, the driver keeps the fare and the service fee is deducted from the next payout.

lost-report.text: Report a lost item within 72 hours from Trip History with "I lost an item"; the app connects you to the driver by masked call.

lost-return.text: Having the driver bring the item costs a ₱50 return fee (₱25 for Plus members); picking it up at the driver's TODA terminal is free.

lost-terminal.text: Items handed in are kept at the driver's TODA terminal, or at the Tricycall office for non-TODA drivers.
source: lost-and-found.md#If the driver cannot be reached

lost-kept.text: Lost items are kept for 30 days, then donated, except IDs and documents, which go to the government office that issued them.

disp-what.text: You can dispute a fare, surcharge, cancellation fee, no-show charge, Pasabuy charge or lost-item return fee, within 7 days of the trip.

disp-refunds.text: Refunds: wallet within 1 business day; GCash or Maya in 3 to 5 business days; debit card in 7 to 14 business days; cash trips as wallet credit within 1 business day.

disp-second.text: A second review can be requested within 14 days of the first decision, and it is final.

priv-collect.text: Tricycall collects name, mobile number and email; ID photos and numbers; trip details and GPS; payment tokens; ratings, comments and support conversations.

priv-norecord.text: Tricycall does not record audio or video during trips.

priv-nocard.text: Tricycall never stores full card numbers.

priv-nosell.text: Tricycall does not sell personal data or share it with advertisers.

priv-gps.text: Trip GPS data is kept for 12 months, then anonymized.

upd-villa.text: Villa Aurora is planned to open on December 1, 2026; its fares will be announced before launch, and rides can't be booked there until then.

comm-not-policy.text: The community tips are riders' personal advice, not official Tricycall policy.

comm-cash.text: Riders suggest carrying small bills, since early-morning drivers often lack change for ₱500, and linking GCash as a backup.
